symptom: `textbox (Label: 'x', ShowLabel: false)` (and checkbox, textarea, datepicker, dropdown, radiobuttons) still renders its label; check and exec are clean
cause: no input builder read ShowLabel (it is whitelisted in staticWidgetKnownProps, so nothing warned) and each set Label whenever one was given
insight: Mendix stores "Show label: No" as LabelTemplate null — the writer's no-label case — so the fix is to drop the label, not to set a flag. Verified on 11.14: describe shows no Label and mx check is clean. Describe's extractShowLabel reads a TextVisible field the metamodel does not have (dead code)
